messages:
jess: Quick sync — ACME HW wants to list on Azure marketplace in April. We need a tight compliance cadence: SOC report, pen test, vendor questionnaire, and artifact bundle. Who can own each piece?

ajay: I can own the pen-test coordination. Need partner SOW and the exact scope (network, infra, app). Also confirm whether they have a recent SOC2 Type II PDF or only an attestation letter.

maria: Product target announcement is 2026-04-12. We need final attestation + sanitized artifacts at least 48h before. If any gating items, call them out this week.

kai: Eng will produce architecture diagram, network segmentation, TLS cert list, and a minimal config dump. Prefer S3 presigned share. Example presign command we use for partners: ```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/acme-hw/2026-03-xx --expires-in 604800```

jess: @ajay can you confirm pen start window? Partner suggested late march but didn't give dates. Also who will do artifact redaction?

ajay: Aim to start pen 2026-03-25, 10 business days. That gives us time for remediation before the April announcement. I can share our pen vendor and also run an internal quick-scan first. Need partner contact + SOW by Tue.

olivia: Legal: we'll need redacted SOC docs (no vendor customer data), signed AUP/NDA in place for pen testers, and confirmation on what marketing copy they're okay with. I can draft redaction guidance and a short attestation template.

kai: For uploads: who will own S3 bucket lifecycle/retention? We should set short TTL for presigned links (7 days) and index a manifest. I can automate upload if someone gives me the partner creds or we create an upload token.

jess: I'll own the checklist and the shared doc. I'll create a doc titled "ACME HW marketplace compliance cadence" and assign owners: Ajay = pen, Kai = artifact upload/scripts, Olivia = redaction/attest, Maria = announcement gating. I'll ping partner for SOW/contact now.

maria: If anything slips, delay announcement by a week — but let's try to keep the 4/12 date. Product needs a green/amber/red status by 2026-03-29.

ajay: Noted. I'll post pen vendor options and a sample SOW in the doc. Also request the partner's SOC2 PDF and their public cert chain.

jess: Ok — I'll post the doc link here when ready and @mention owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: artifact-bucket created: s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/acme-hw/2026-03- (permissions: restricted)

jess: Great — moving to owners. Will update with partner SOW and doc link within the hour.
